noClone.title: This repository has no clone yet
noClone.body: DevDigest reads the tour's facts straight from the clone on disk. The clone job has not finished for this repository, so there is nothing to generate a tour from yet.

generate.title: Generate onboarding tour
generate.body: One structured model call turns the facts DevDigest already holds — the file ranking, the dependency chains, the manifests, the task files and the open `good first issue` issues — into five sections: architecture overview, critical paths, how to run locally, a guided reading path, and first tasks.

phase.facts: Reading manifests, task files and the example env file
phase.graph: Reading the file ranking and dependency chains
phase.markers: Looking for TODO and FIXME markers
phase.issues: Fetching issues labelled good first issue
phase.verifying: Checking every path against the clone

header.headMoved: the head has moved from {tourSha} to {currentSha}
header.noExcerpts: No file excerpts were used — this repository is above the excerpt cutoff.
header.dropped: {rows} row(s) and {steps} run step(s) were dropped for naming files that do not exist.

cost.none: No usage was recorded for this tour.

reason.no_index: The repository is not indexed, so the tour was built from deterministic facts alone.
reason.partial_index: The repository's index is incomplete, so parts of the tour were built from deterministic facts.
reason.repo_too_large: The repository is above the excerpt cutoff, so no file excerpts reached the model.
reason.model_failed: The model call failed, so the tour below is the deterministic skeleton. Retry to try again.
reason.issues_unavailable: GitHub issues could not be read, so first tasks come from TODO and FIXME markers alone.
reason.clone_unavailable: The repository's clone could not be read when the tour was generated, so no facts were collected. Retry once the clone is back on disk.
